text:
kevin-partnerships: Heads-up — just got a note from @beth-hw at NitroSystems: they have a production hold on a few A100 lots. Impact: some Dedicated reservations for mid-April could be delayed. Want to surface now so we can triage options.
sarah-platform: Ugh. Which reservations specifically? any enterprise SLAs affected?
beth-hw: Sorry team — confirmed hold due to a supply chain QC batch. A100 lot #4 delayed ~2–3 weeks. We have partial shipments that could go to priority customers if you give us a list.
jordan-ops: We have two mid-April commitments for Dedicated: acct-zenith (high-priority commit) and acct-borealis (standard reserved). Zenith is on a signed reserved capacity contract.
lina-sales: Zenith is enterprise, signed 12-month commit, penalties kick in if we miss. We need a workaround asap.
sam-eng: Short-term options: 1) swap to compatible GPUs in our Dedicated pools (A10/T4) with perf caveats, 2) route traffic to Hosted with burst capacity, 3) partial fulfillment (some racks) + staggered rollouts.
sarah-platform: Can we quantify perf delta? need to tell sales what to expect.
sam-eng: Ballpark: A10 at 1/2 token throughput vs A100 for some models, latency up ~20–40% depending on batch and seq. For embeddings models less severe.
kevin-partnerships: @beth-hw can you accept a prioritized short list for the partial shipments? We'll offer credits to standard customers that get bumped.
beth-hw: Yes, if you give a 10-customer priority list by EOD we can reallocate the partial shipment. We'll need signed acknowledgement for the reallocation.
jordan-ops: I can prepare the list. Also, can we push customer-facing fallback to Hosted for non-critical tenants? ops-bot: Deploy plan suggestion: run automated routing policy to prefer region-us-east-2 hosted pools when Dedicated nodes unavailable.
kevin-partnerships: Good. @sarah-platform please prepare routing policy patch and cost estimate for Lina to present. Lina, also draft proposed customer credits and SLA addendum to cover delay.
sarah-platform: Will do. Draft routing snippet below for the edge router (example):
```
fallback_policy:
  - scope: reserved_capacity
    fallback_to: hosted_us_east_2
    max_percent: 30
    note: "apply only during capacity shortfalls"
```
kevin-partnerships: Also, check marketplace options — any cloud marketplace SKUs we can spin up quickly?
beth-hw: If swapping to A10, we can rush-configure racks but will need a 10% expedite fee.
lina-sales: I'll run numbers on credits + expedite fee vs contractual penalties and update legal.
sam-eng: If we use hosted bursts, set smart-cache prefixes so customers keep warm KV caches; otherwise perf will tank during failover.
jordan-ops: I'll add KV cache warmers to the plan. Also raising an incident ticket to track this: INC-2026-0421.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 created by jordan-ops — "Partner GPU hold impacting Dedicated reservations" — priority P2.
kevin-partnerships: Thanks all. Action items: @jordan-ops list for partial shipments by 5pm, @sarah-platform routing patch + perf delta table, @lina-sales credits proposal, @beth-hw confirm expedite cost and earliest ship date. We'll reconvene in #partnerships standup tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
